Name: Calzone Oven
Author: CactusWithGlasses
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Ever want to enjoy the delicious taste of a fresh calzone in Stardew Valley? Well now you can![/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Had a friend who just really likes calzones, and realized that in all the mods I've ever played, I've never seen someone add them, so I decided to do it myself![/color][/size]

[color=#d4d4d8]Calzones are an artisan good that can be made in the new Calzone Oven machine that you can purchase the crafting recipe for from Gus. There are two calzone variants, 'plain' and 'stuffed'.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Plain Calzones are made with 1 cheese and 1 wheat flour, and have the same stats as a vanilla pizza, but now as an artisan good.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Stuffed Calzones accept a stuffing and uses 1 cheese and wheat flour just like the plain variant. Acceptable stuffings include:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Meat_item and category_meat items: Can't go wrong with the classics when it comes to calzone flavors![/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Category_fish items: I know sardines are the 'normal' pizza topping option, but if I was going to let you use sardines, why not get wild with any fish your heart desires?[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Category_vegetable items: All sorts of veggies go great on pizza, and good if you wanna make a vegetarian calzone instead![/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Category_fruits items: Be it hot peppers or pineapple, some people like fruits on their pizzas, so why not let you stuff them in your calzone too?[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Edible_flower_item and category_greens items (With at least an ediblity of 1): Forage for the foods you like to eat the most, there's a variety of forage that would go great in a calzone. And a bunch more that I'm not so sure about, but that's YOUR choice, I don't judge. [s]Publicly[/s].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]And cheese_item tagged items: for if you want to do a cheese blend with other cheese options. There's no shortages of cheese mods out there after all![/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]+ in the future, maybe more! Be sure to let me know if there's mods out there that have unique tags that you think would go great stuffed in a calzone. Or cursed things because its funny. I'll see about future updates for making my mod more compatible.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8]Stuffed Calzones increase the ingredient's value by 1.1 and then adds the base value of the calzone. In the future I'd like it to also change its edibility, with higher value ingredients making more restorative calzones, but that feature eluded my limited abilities (for now).[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]This was my first experiment with a custom machine, artisan good, as well as items that accept the color of their input item. This is also my first mod with sprites that I didn't use vanilla Stardew sprites as chopped up references (for the calzones at least, the oven is a mashing together of a furnace and the oven sprites). So learned a lot here, and my sprites are probably the least happy I've been so far with my art, so a future update might be a total rework as my skills increase.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]But beyond that, this was a very fun project. I hope you all enjoy making whatever stuffed calzones your hearts desire. Again, I don't judge [s]much[/s].[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Install like any other Content Patcher Mod, however this mod does also require Extra Machine Configs.

-Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Configs[/url]
-Install my mod's main file, extract it, and copy the '[CP] Calzone Oven' folder to your 'Mods' folder
-Launch Stardew Valley with SMAPI [/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Requires  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Configs[/url] [/color]

I also recommend mods that add more item options so you can have more fun experimenting, as well as mods that add items that use some of the non-vanilla context tags, like the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url] plus mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28023]Rose's Cruelty Free Meat[/url] for non butcher options for meat items, if that's what you want to make with my mod!

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Big shoutout to my friend who just really liked calzones for inspiring this. Took a lot longer than I expected to, but I'm glad I finally got it out.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]And as always, the modding community in general for inspiring me to want to make new, silly options to expand what you can do on your farms![/color][/size]
